profile.headline: Software Engineer at SAIC
profile.geoLocationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
profile.summary: I am a software engineer, with a financial services and banking background, experienced in working in an Agile environment, delivering responsive, reliable, and user-friendly web applications for federal and municipality projects. As a programmer with government contractors, I completed apps using my JavaScript, React/Redux, NodeJS, Express, MongoDB, Mongoose, TypeScript, Jest/Enzyme, and SASS skills. I am also a lifelong learner always looking to acquire new technical expertise, including graduating Summa Cum Laude with an Associate’s degree in Cybersecurity.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
+ Developed and maintained a network stress testing application for Cisco routers and switches. Frontend: Built with React (Hooks), JavaScript, and Sass for a responsive UI. Backend: Developed using GoLang and MySQL for high-performance data processing. Containerized the full-stack application with Docker to ensure consistent deployments across all environments.

+ Deployed the app on AWS using a scalable cloud architecture, utilizing CloudFront for frontend content delivery, Elastic Container Service (ECS) for containerized backend deployment, and Aurora MySQL for high-availability database management.

+ Implemented test-driven development for the app by building Cypress end-to-end tests and Ginkgo backend unit tests, significantly reducing production defects and improving code reliability.

+ Collaborated with DevOps to build CI/CD pipelines using Terraform, AWS CodeBuild, and CodePipeline, enabling automated testing and deployment workflows that reduced release cycles.

+ Delivered features iteratively in an Agile/Scrum environment with bi-weekly sprints, utilizing Jira for backlog management and sprint planning to ensure alignment with business priorities.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
+ Built SPA user-interface (JavaScript, React, Redux, Hooks, TypeScript, and Sass) for Grantor Experience 2.0 project with positive stakeholder feedback; enabled viewing and managing of grants via intuitive, fast, performant, and content-rich app. 

+ Collaborated in an Agile team using Jira ticketing system, Confluence, and Bitbucket to secure a smooth and effective workflow; successfully met all deadlines and completed approximately 15 story points each sprint. 

+ Delivered clean code with 100% success, passing all tests, focusing on test-driven development, and writing unit tests with Jest/Enzyme for greatest efficiency. 

+ Teamed with DevOps and Testing staff on Jenkins CI/CD pipelines, JAWS testing, application debugging, and application documenting for a faster deployment, debugging, and documenting process and on-time release of new features.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
+ Developed from scratch, using JavaScript, React, Redux, React Hooks, and Material UI library, a CFSA Community Portal, a React-based application for social workers in Washington, DC to track child abuse cases. Most end users reported high level of satisfaction with application due to user-friendly, fast, and functional capabilities. 

+ Collaborated with Java backend developers to design clear and concise API endpoints for the application. 

+ Quickly and accurately resolved errors and bugs found while participating in user acceptance testing, application debugging, application documenting, and end-user training; received encouraging feedback on end users’ training.
